elaine_ml: Heads-up: auklet-v1q int8 canary is flaking on funcalls. ~2% of invokes return non-JSON (missing expected 'tool' object) when kv-cache is enabled. Repro on canary batch run.

raj: ugh. saw similar in another model — usually a suffix/truncation at token boundary from batching. any sample payloads?

maria: can you paste a minimal example from the failing set? also what's the retry budget and mirror configuration for the canary?

elaine_ml: sample attached (sanitized). reproduced locally:

```
{"request_id":"abc123","response":"{\"action\": \"call_tool\", \"args\": {}}\n\u0000"\n```

notice the trailing control char + newline. json parser chokes. this only shows up with kvcache+continuous-batching enabled.

priya: try two quick probes:
1) run same canary with --disable-kvcache and see failure rate.
2) increase retry_budget to 3 for funcalls only and capture raw token stream.

command i used:
`./scripts/run_canary.py --model auklet-v1q --quant int8 --disable-kvcache --sample 5k`

raj: also try setting tokenizer.normalize_control_chars=true in runtime config — we've seen control-char passthrough in some kernels.

elaine_ml: ran probe 1: failure drops to 0.3% with kvcache off. so kvcache looks implicated. probe 2 (retry_budget=3) made most cases recover, but it's masking the root cause.

ci-bot: CI canary summary 2025-02-07: auklet-v1q int8 — baseline pass 98.2% fail 1.8% (kvcache on). mirror run (kvcache off) pass 99.7%.

maria: thanks. plan: create a small instrumented build that logs raw token boundaries and kv-prefix snapshots for failing invokes. if we can capture last 32 tokens before truncation we can see whether kernel dropped a byte.

devops-bot: FYI runtime-v2 will enable a safer kernel fallback for int8 streaming on next deploy. canary flag: runtime.kernel_fallback=true

priya: also add a soft json-healer in postprocess: if parse fails, run a tiny heuristic repair (strip control chars, ensure trailing brace) before retrying. low-risk and helps customer impact while we root-cause.

elaine_ml: agreed. i'll:
- open a small PR with token-boundary logging + kvcache snapshot
- land a postprocess json-healer behind a feature flag
- run full canary (50k samples) and post results here

raj: sgtm. ping me on PR for a quick review. :thumbsup:

maria: assign me the bisect if logs point to kernel boundary. i'll check kernel selection & quant packing path.

elaine_ml: thanks team — kicking off the 50k run now, will update with CI summary and selected failing examples.
